query: INSERT INTO ops.tasks(task_type,object_type,object_id,title,status,priority) SELECT 'SIGNAL_TRIAGE','SIGNAL',$1,'Triage detected signal','OPEN', CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'URGENT' WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'NORMAL' END FROM core.anomaly_signals WHERE id=$1 AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ops.tasks WHERE task_type='SIGNAL_TRIAGE' AND object_id=$1 AND status<>'DONE')
